Animal Rescue Brigade is dedicated to rescuing, treating, and caring for stray animals.

Our mission is simple:
Saving one dog won't change the world, but it will change the world for that one dog.

On this channel, we share:
• Animal rescue stories
• Dog treatment & recovery
• Street feeding
• Adoption stories
• Awareness about stray animals

📍 https://maps.app.goo.gl/kruua4qXNfv93NpLA

Support our mission by subscribing to and sharing our videos.
